prep.summary: Review your last sync with Justin on August 21—the discussion focused on the Cloud Review Process necessity for the Gemini API call and the architectural risks of missing the 90-day deadline if you pivot to an alternative model. Review Abe's forwarded email thread regarding GCP dependencies—clarify the broader organizational strategy for Gemini longevity.

prep.summary: You must align on the outcomes of the August 27 meeting—specifically the transition of Jonathan into McCarty’s vacated role and the implementation of daily spreadsheet syncs by Nate. The team established strict mapping rules requiring applications to tie minimally to Level 3 capabilities—using placeholder L3s to avoid direct L1 mapping—while utilizing pointers to track cross-platform tool dependencies. Michael Summers scheduled a Monday meeting with the Strategy and APO teams to prevent taxonomy divergence—all while introducing TIME metadata and UUIDs to automate future-state roadmaps.
tasks: Finalize Level 1 and Level 2 capability mappings in the central spreadsheet—ensuring compliance with the newly established L3 placeholder rules.
Align with Michael Summers regarding the Monday session with the Strategy and APO teams—preventing unnecessary divergence between architectural and business taxonomies.
Incorporate TIME lifecycle metadata and UUIDs into the spreadsheet—facilitating automated Gantt charts and target roadmaps.
Audit the cross-platform dependency links to ensure tools like FiveTran and Kafka are mapped via pointers—avoiding duplicate ownership across domains.
prep.title: Platform strategy

prep.summary: You must review the alignment from the August 24th sync—the Member Value team is actively establishing ownership of the cross-association NBE roadmap while expanding their leadership. The current architectural plan rejects replacing Pega CDH with Salesforce's native engine—you will instead integrate Salesforce CRM with the PCA API to deliver curated offers to agents. Furthermore, Salesforce CDP will replace the legacy XT pipeline—establishing a new baseline for audience ingestion—while teams evaluate real-time transcription cues to dynamically refresh active call offers.
tasks: Integrate Salesforce CRM with the existing PCA API to surface Pega-curated offers in the agent UI.
Transition all primary ingestion and insight sources from the legacy XT pipeline to Salesforce CDP.
Align with Mac Wheeler on the onboarding timeline for the new AVP and Director of Product.
Establish the architecture for the real-time intelligence layer—focusing on dynamic offer invalidation during live calls.
